study.title: Fitness Effects of Single Amino Acid Insertions and Deletions in TEM-1 β-Lactamase

notation: ProteinGym v1.3 indels assay files carry NO mutant notation column (columns: mutated_sequence,DMS_score,DMS_score_bin). variant column here was DERIVED by diffing mutated_sequence against target_seq under the HGVS 3'-rule (deletions/insertions shifted right; insertion equal to the preceding k residues written as dup): single-residue insertions 4493 (position-2 library, e.g. M1_S2insA; insertions duplicating the anchor residue become dup, e.g. M1dup), single-residue deletions 258 (e.g. S2del). All 4751/4751 variants parse with gb1.variant_notation.parse_variant, pass validate_variant against wt_sequence, and round-trip (apply_mutations(wt, parse_variant(v)) == mutated_sequence). fitness = DMS_score raw string value. Multi-mutation separator (none present here) would be ','.
